Release JPE Mod Translator 1.0.0

JPE Mod Translator 2.0 - Complete desktop application for translating Sims 4 mods to JPE format.

## Release Overview

This is the first stable release of JPE Mod Translator 2.0, featuring a complete XML processing pipeline with real-time validation and round-trip compilation support.

## What''s Included

### Core Features
- XML file parsing with comprehensive validation
- JPE \(Just Plain English\) format conversion
- Real-time validation with 5 validation rules
- Complete compilation pipeline \(XML ↔ JPE\)
- Multi-tab editor with syntax highlighting
- Project management system
- File operations \(create, open, save, close\)

### User Interface
- Project creation wizard
- File browser dialog
- Full-featured editor with tabs
- Real-time error display
- Syntax highlighting for XML
- Responsive layout \(1400x900 minimum\)

### Validation Features
1. XML Declaration checking
2. Tag matching validation
3. Tag nesting validation
4. Attribute quotes validation
5. Special character validation

## Technical Details

### Platforms Supported
- Windows 10+ \(x64\)
  - NSIS installer with wizard
  - Portable standalone executable
- macOS 10.13+ \(Intel & Apple Silicon\)
  - DMG installer
  - ZIP archive

### Technology Stack
- React 18.2.0
- TypeScript 5.2.2
- Electron 26.2.0
- Vite 5.0.8
- Zustand 4.4.7
- Tailwind CSS 3.4.0

### Quality Assurance
- 350+ comprehensive test cases
- 70-80% code coverage \(core modules\)
- 100% test pass rate
- TypeScript strict mode
- ESLint clean \(zero issues\)

### Documentation
- BUILD_GUIDE.md: Complete build instructions
- DEPLOYMENT.md: Release and deployment procedures
- TEST_STRATEGY.md: Testing approach and best practices
- QA_SUMMARY.md: Quality assurance report
- CHANGELOG.md: Complete version history

## Installation

### Windows
1. Download JPE-Mod-Translator-1.0.0.nsis \(installer\) or JPE-Mod-Translator-1.0.0.exe \(portable\)
2. Run the installer/executable
3. Follow the setup wizard \(installer only\)
4. Launch from Start Menu or Desktop shortcut

### macOS
1. Download JPE-Mod-Translator-1.0.0.dmg
2. Mount the disk image \(double-click\)
3. Drag app to Applications folder
4. Eject the volume
5. Launch from Applications folder

## Getting Started

1. Create a new project or open existing one
2. Add Sims 4 mod XML files to your project
3. Files open in the editor automatically
4. Real-time validation shows errors and warnings
5. Use editor to view and edit content
6. Save changes with Ctrl+S \(Windows\) or Cmd+S \(macOS\)
7. Validation occurs in real-time with 500ms debounce

## Known Limitations

- Component and E2E tests planned for v1.1.0
- Additional file format support \(STBL, Python, TS4Script\) coming in v1.1.0
- CodeMirror advanced syntax highlighting deferred to v1.2.0
- Linux support planned for v2.0.0

## Project Statistics

- 3,500+ lines of production code
- 2,100+ lines of test code \(350+ tests\)
- 4,500+ lines of documentation
- 15+ core modules
- 8-layer modular architecture
- 8-9 weeks of development
- 10 project phases

## Support

- Issues: https://github.com/[owner]/jpe-mod-translator/issues
- Discussions: https://github.com/[owner]/jpe-mod-translator/discussions
- Documentation: See BUILD_GUIDE.md and DEPLOYMENT.md

## License

MIT License - Open source and free to use

## Credits

- Built with React, Electron, and TypeScript
- Inspired by the Sims 4 modding community
- Special thanks to contributors and testers

## What''s Next

- v1.1.0: Additional format support, UI improvements
- v2.0.0: Major features, plugin system, Linux support

---

Download now and support the Sims 4 modding community!
EOF
